}}'''''Koh-Lanta: La Revanche des Héros''''' is the third special season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' and the fourteenth season overall. It was broadcast on TF1 from April 6 to June 1, 2012, with episodes airing at 8:45&nbsp;p.m.

[[Bertrand Bolle]] defeated [[Claude Dartois]] in a 9-1 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].
==Twists/Changes==
*'''[[Returning Players/Koh-Lanta|Returning Players]]:''' All the castaways are players from previous seasons.
*'''Sudden Death Challenges:''' Two additional sudden death challenges took place this season, one on Day 2 and another on Day 21. The castaway who finishes in last in the challenge would automatically be eliminated.
* '''[[Hidden Immunity Idol|Hidden Immunity Necklace]]:''' Necklaces could be played at [[Tribal Council]] after the votes have been cast but before they have been read. All votes cast against the castaway it was played for would not count.
* '''Black Vote:''' The Black Vote allows a previously eliminated castaway to take revenge by casting a vote against one of the remaining castaways on their tribe. It would count at the castaway's next Tribal Council.
*'''[[Ambassadors]]:''' The purpose of the summit for this season is for the ambassadors to nominate a tribe member each to compete in a [[duel]]. The winner of the duel would stay in the game, while the loser would be eliminated.
* '''Final''' '''Five:''' Instead of occurring at the final four, the standard orienteering challenge occurred at the final five, with the two losers being eliminated.
